mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals worsening labor market conditions, prompting aggressive monetary policy responses that drive S&P 500 returns positive within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE increases by more than 0.5pp in a month, SPX 5-day returns are negative in over 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a broad-based consumer demand collapse, which triggers a coordinated monetary and fiscal policy response that results in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and HOUST decline in the same month
failure_condition: When RSAFS and HOUST both decline in a month, SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of severe industrial contraction (INDPRO below 90), the Federal Reserve's aggressive policy easing leads to positive S&P 500 returns within 20 trading days as investors anticipate economic stabilization.
failure_condition: When INDPRO is below 90, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.25% over two consecutive months signals an emergency monetary policy response, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in the policy easing.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS falls below 0.25% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS has been below 0.25% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (above 8.0%) consistently correlates with elevated equity market volatility and subsequent positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days as the market anticipates policy intervention.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 8.0%, SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of declining retail sales (RSAFS), the S&P 500 tends to rebound within 20 trading days due to anticipated fiscal stimulus and monetary easing.
failure_condition: When RSAFS declines, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and real GDP (GDPC1) indicates a severe economic contraction, which triggers aggressive policy responses that lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO and GDPC1 decline in the same quarter
failure_condition: When INDPRO and GDPC1 both decline in a quarter, SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of cases.
